tests.suite: Includes runtime constants, typed joins, absolute layout/cells, stack transport, app cursors/spans/counted and counter-relative loops, affine values, hardware summaries/relative tracking, and direct-call graph scaling.

implementation: Known same-section direct CALL edges transport the pre-call register/platform packet through existing shared instruction-entry transfer and joins. Caller-private stack/cells and A7 are not imported. Existing summaries still own return effects.
Sparse CALL predecessor CSR and one call_target per existing node; no second transfer engine or dense per-node slot arrays. Unknown/indirect/cross-section calls are not guessed.

Explicit code/runtime entries, address-taken pointers, declared/inferred callback tables, direct function contracts and newly discovered pointer escapes retain unknown independent entry inputs. Exposures are monotone across converged epochs.

A pointee/register annotation constrains the instruction state; it does not invent a control-flow ingress. Native failing-before/passing-after regression separates that from explicit code entry. Target pool header source0x16DC4 retains17 rows,250 iterations,stride68.

Current source-pointer position joins lose inconsistent exact coordinates independently of whole-value layout/raw/entry identities. Backedge-first and reversed-order fixtures converge without raising visit limits.

Current An must-equality uses canonical equivalence classes in the existing eight slots; joins intersect relations. Physical writes split the destination; WORD copies do not equate full values; opaque memory effects preserve held CPU equality. ABI interpretation refinement does not simulate a register write.

Final inferred app references are rebuilt from converged call states. Explicit use-site bindings are retained; contradicted hardware/library/other-layout fallback interpretations are filtered before the loop engine borrows node storage.

typed_delta.interpretation: 14 added and19 retracted sites, net-5. Retractions group rating-score/audio/reference record iterators and saved-nearby/projector placement consumers. They are no longer inferred fields at the converged state; do not call each old fact false or each loss semantic completion. Canonical record definitions remain intact.

development_findings: First call-input run reached1898560 visits with5pending; rejected before build/source adoption. Current-position byte_cursor join caused repeated advancing pointer preference at source0x52F0.

After pointer join repair the same cap remained in polygon interpolation; trace isolated directional copy-ancestry churn. Canonical must-equality intersection removes that order-dependent component. No visit cap was raised.
Initial converged target run lost17 pool loop rows due to treating a register seed as an independent flow root. Regression and control/type separation restore all135 loop patterns before publication.
performance_scope: Final native generation226.71s and process256.47s/2678692KiB. Prior converged candidate172.87s had a precision defect; not a fair speed baseline. These are observed workflow costs, not an isolated performance claim.
remaining: Logical app provenance is not an unconditional physical A6/base proof. The secondary cache holder runtime0x4E5C0 still needs its exact reaching producer/alias/call and loop relation.

An equality is not general Dn/memory alias tracking. Absence of a must-equality relation never proves disjointness. Next focused experiment: full-width An-to-Dn-to-An transport followed by an input-memory write/cache read, contrasting partial overwrite.
19 retracted typed sites require current-coordinate/record-stride evidence before re-promotion, not unconditional type seeds or restoring old first-predecessor behavior.

Canonical rendered symbol bindings are not erased merely because a native app interpretation is retracted. The historical app_0127 operand at source0xBC3A is an ExecBase use and remains an explicitly identified source-quality follow-up.
Known original CFG inputs only; no claim for arbitrary callbacks/replacement code, all generic names, all orphan islands or every gameplay path. No new emulator run or interim archive.
